targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM inventory.sites) AS "Data Centers",(SELECT count(*) FROM inventory.racks) AS "Racks",(SELECT count(*) FROM inventory.servers) AS "Servers",(SELECT count(*) FROM inventory.virtual_machines) AS "Virtual Machines",(SELECT count(*) FROM inventory.applications) AS "Applications",(SELECT count(*) FROM inventory.network_devices) AS "Network Devices",(SELECT round(100.0*sum(used_rack_units)/nullif(sum(rack_units),0)) FROM inventory.racks) AS "Rack Utilization",(SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE health_status='healthy') FROM inventory.servers) AS "Server Healthy",(SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE health_status='warning') FROM inventory.servers) AS "Server Warning",(SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE health_status='critical') FROM inventory.servers) AS "Server Critical",(SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='running') FROM inventory.virtual_machines) AS "VM Running",(SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE status<>'running') FROM inventory.virtual_machines) AS "VM Stopped",(SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='active') FROM inventory.applications) AS "App Healthy",(SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='maintenance') FROM inventory.applications) AS "App Warning",(SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE status NOT IN ('active','maintenance')) FROM inventory.applications) AS "App Critical",(SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='active') FROM inventory.network_devices) AS "Network Online",(SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE status<>'active') FROM inventory.network_devices) AS "Network Offline",(SELECT round(100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE health_status='healthy')/nullif(count(*),0)) FROM inventory.servers) AS "System Health",(SELECT count(*) FROM events.inventory_alerts WHERE status<>'resolved') AS "Open Alerts",(SELECT count(*) FROM events.inventory_alerts WHERE entity_type='site' AND opened_at>now()-interval '24 hours') AS "Security Events",(SELECT round(100.0*sum(used_rack_units)/nullif(sum(rack_units),0)) FROM inventory.racks) AS "Capacity",(SELECT count(*) FROM events.inventory_alerts WHERE status='open' AND severity='warning') AS "Predicted Issues",(SELECT count(*) FROM events.inventory_alerts WHERE status='open' AND metric_name IS NOT NULL) AS "AI Anomalies",(SELECT count(*) FROM events.inventory_alerts WHERE status<>'resolved' AND severity='critical') AS "Alerts Critical",(SELECT count(*) FROM events.inventory_alerts WHERE status<>'resolved' AND severity='warning') AS "Alerts Warning"
